failure_modes.mode: External search links mistaken for imported vacancies
failure_modes.effect: False claim of in-app coverage or empty-result success
failure_modes.detection: Assert explicit external-board labels and unchanged vacancy counts after search
failure_modes.mitigation: Separate search links, saved vacancies and automatic imports; show exact next action

failure_modes.mode: Endless loading or automatic run restart
failure_modes.cause: Disabled wait cursor, unbounded polling or re-render retries
failure_modes.effect: User cannot tell whether search finished
failure_modes.detection: Browser idle, terminal, transport error and bounded polling tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Normal disabled cursor, finite status polling, explicit terminal actions, no start calls from polling

failure_modes.cause: Using latest global pipeline status without checking run identity
failure_modes.effect: Wrong results or stopping a UK workflow
failure_modes.mitigation: Bind status/cancel to owned NZ discover run and campaign history

failure_modes.mode: Advanced setup still blocks first search
failure_modes.cause: Required employer/CV/source fields in primary form
failure_modes.detection: Search with no employers, CVs or configured sources; browser first viewport test
failure_modes.mitigation: Two-field search form; optional save/details and progressive disclosure

failure_modes.mode: Old UI response or polling overwrites edits
failure_modes.effect: Lost inputs or incorrect active page
failure_modes.detection: Late response and country-switch browser tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Existing render tokens plus owned search generation, abortable requests and detached-view polling exit
